Dace.fixed: Driftfolk woman of about fifty (out of Lashing), long weather-beaten tanned face with deep creases, grey-brown hair tied back, a clay pipe in her teeth, a soft hat tied on with string under the chin, worn patched olive canvas coat. Expressions: dace_cheerful (base), dace_dry, dace_pain. Ch09 adds dace_grave and dace_questioning from the same look.

Yeva.fixed: the Wellwalker, tall lean woman of about sixty-five with a long worn face, weathered olive-tan skin, long grey hair tied back loosely, dry manner; plain worn grey-green sea-silk tunic. Expressions: yeva_dry (base), yeva_stern, yeva_tired.

Pell.fixed: thin nervous young man of about twenty-five, a filing clerk of the Clean Hands, pale light skin, neat short dark-brown hair, narrow face; pale-grey jacket over a shirt and dull tie. Expressions: pell_nervous, pell_earnest.

Linnea Marsh.fixed: physician and chief of Brightwater, about sixty-five, light skin, short practical grey hair, fine lines, calm exact face; plain dark raincoat with the collar turned up. Expressions: marsh_flat, marsh_hesitant, marsh_humble.

Garran.fixed: big slow dock porter of about forty with a broken nose, tan weathered skin, short dark hair, dark stubble, thick neck; coarse sleeveless olive work shirt with a rope over one shoulder. Expressions: garran_wary, garran_accepting.

Wrack (ch08 variants).fixed: same Wrack with the Thread line on the neck. With hat (from c08.s01, Dace gives it): plain soft dark-grey short-brimmed hat, tunic: wrack_hat_guarded, wrack_hat_melancholy, wrack_hat_calm. In the Brightwater suit (c08.s05): dark charcoal business suit, white shirt, loosened tie, no hat: wrack_suit_cool, wrack_suit_sorrowful. Without hat: wrack_thread_wry, wrack_thread_straining.

places.Belt, grey twilight (underwater): cold grey-green water looking up at a heaving surface with dim shafts of light (bg c8_belt_under); underwater.
places.Belt, rain walls: open sea from a boat's bow under a bruised purple-grey sky with walls of rain (bg c8_belt_rain).
places.Eye of the storm: the patched boat on pale sea-green glassy water under a round ring of blue sky inside a circular cloud wall (bg c8_eye_boat).
places.Boat in black rain: the patched boat among steep grey sea hills in rain (bg c8_boat_storm).
places.Saltgate: a hundred black sea-stacks built over with tiers of buildings, neon signs of abstract shapes, evening rain (bg c8_saltgate).
places.Saltgate lock: open rusted iron gates between barnacled pilings, empty glass boxes above lit with neon (bg c8_lock).
places.Canal wall with the poster: stone wall across a canal with a weathered poster showing a plain-faced black-haired man, no lettering (bg c8_poster_canal).
places.Wet Market: roofed basin, three tiers of stalls, lowest a metre under water, lamps on chains (bg c8_wet_market); lowest tier with plank table and basins (bg c8_market_low).
places.The Sluice: narrow back canal, leaning tenements, washing lines, noodle stall with a plain curtain, one lit fourth-floor window (bg c8_sluice).
places.Noodle shop window: window sill, the tower across the canal with the blue drop and sun sign (bg c8_noodle_window).
places.Brightwater Wellness Centre: thirty-storey white-tiled tower, fountain plaza, blue drop and smiling sun sign (bg c8_brightwater_ext); white lobby (c8_lobby); tank room with an empty glass cylinder (c8_tank_room); flooded emergency stair (c8_stair_flooded); loading dock on the canal at night (c8_loading_dock).
places.Under the Wet Market: forest of barnacled pilings in calm blue-green tide water, plank ledge, lamp slits overhead (bg c8_under_market).
